title: SXT-015 resource account (one normalized graph)
description: Result of model.resources.accounting.account_graph() over one corpus/normalized/graphs.jsonl line. Deterministic bookkeeping model only: NO technology/area/cycle measurement (SXT-016), NO profile freeze (SXT-017), NO fidelity or preset-quality claim, NO hardware claim. Cycle values use the named placeholder-v0 cost profile so the closure machinery is executable; every placeholder is listed in the parameter registry.

inputs.graph_line: one JSON object from corpus/normalized/graphs.jsonl (SXT-011 schema sxt-011-normalized-graph-schema/1.0.0; engine pin 58914e59c608ed4384ba6002e44c3465c58b2e71)
inputs.fx_instance_limit: candidate limit applied to ENABLED instances (null = distribution mode); distinct from supported-type counts
inputs.parameters: model/resources/params.py registry; digest committed into every account as params_digest

top_level.model_version: string, semantic version of this accounting model
top_level.params_digest: 16-hex sha256 prefix of the parameter registry JSON used
top_level.cost_profile: name of the cycle-cost profile (placeholder-v0; SXT-016 replaces)
top_level.path: census path of the input graph
top_level.sha: git blob SHA-1 of the source .fxp
top_level.input_status: normalized | analysis_failure (echoes the SXT-011 line status)
top_level.status: fit | rejected | analysis_failure. analysis_failure FAILS CLOSED: every cost object below is null and no default cost is ever produced
top_level.scene: {scene_mode_id, scene_mode_name, active_scenes} (scene mode outside the pinned sm_single..sm_chsplit ids is unaccountable => analysis_failure)
top_level.anomalies: explicit anomaly records (data gaps, clamps, exposure gaps); never silent
top_level.rejections: explicit rejection objects; non-empty => status rejected

voice_object.scene_mode_id: 0 single, 1 split, 2 dual, 3 chsplit (SurgeStorage.h:168-171); unknown ids are unaccountable
voice_object.voices_per_note: 1, except dual mode = 2 (a layered note consumes two pool voices, plan section 3)
voice_object.polylimit: graph polylimit (loader default 16 applies when the file did not store it)
voice_object.unison_osc_instances_worst_case: worst_case_voices * max over active scenes of (sum of effective unison over ACTIVE osc slots)
voice_object.scene_lfo_instances: len(active_scenes) * n_lfos_scene (6 SLFOs; defs not exported by SXT-011 — flagged)
voice_object.scenes[]: per active scene: osc slots with {muted, modulated, active, unison, wavetable}; filter units; filter config; waveshaper; LFO counts; mseg/formula gaps

osc_slot_activity_rule: an osc slot is active unless (mixer muted or level 0) AND not a modulation destination in the scene's md rows (destination names carry the engine scene prefix, e.g. 'A Osc 2 Pitch'). A muted oscillator that is modulated still processes (census voice-branch rule).
unison_rule: effective unison = max(1, min(raw uni, MAX_UNISON=16)); out-of-range raw values produce an unison_out_of_range anomaly with the raw value; never silently trusted, never silently dropped

fx_instance_object.role: ains1..global4 (engine slot role; routing = role + fixed engine processing order)
fx_instance_object.processes_this_frame: enabled AND route active (scene-B insert routes are inactive in Single scene mode)
fx_instance_object.routing_inactive: true when a scene-B insert slot exists while scene B is inactive: state counted, per-frame cost/traffic NOT counted, anomaly recorded
fx_instance_object.state_bytes: per-INSTANCE state (two Delay slots = two entries, each with its own bytes)
fx_instance_object.external: state class above external_threshold_bytes => external writable memory
fx_instance_object.ext_reads_per_frame/ext_writes_per_frame: words per output frame per instance (placeholder for non-pinned tiers)
fx_instance_object.param_derived: Delay/Floaty Delay only: sr*2^(param+margin) per channel, clamped to the allocated line; ESTIMATE-REF needs SXT-023 confirmation

memory_object.external_writable_state_bytes: sum of per-instance external state (FX long buffers)
memory_object.flash_asset_bytes: embedded wavetable bytes ONLY; flash is never writable delay/reverb storage (plan section 3)
memory_object.ext_traffic_bytes_per_frame: (reads+writes) * mem_word_bytes over instances that process this frame

budget_object.formula: gross = F/Fs; dsp_budget = gross * (1 - reserve); cost = voice + fx + modulation + events; closure = OVERFLOW when cost > dsp_budget
budget_object.note: F and all per-unit cycle costs are placeholder-v0; an OVERFLOW here supports no technology claim

rejection_codes.budget_overflow: complete-patch cost above budget(F, Fs, reserve)
rejection_codes.ext_bandwidth_overflow: required external bandwidth above the named placeholder budget
rejection_codes.event_queue_overflow: fixture worst-case coincident events above queue_depth

anomaly_codes.input_analysis_failure: input line was an SXT-011 analysis_failure; costs are null (fail closed)
anomaly_codes.scene_mode_unaccountable: scene mode id outside the pinned set; analysis_failure
anomaly_codes.unison_out_of_range: raw unison outside 1..MAX_UNISON; clamped and recorded
anomaly_codes.mseg_or_formula_contents_not_exported: SXT-011 exposure gap; LFO state counted, curve contents unaccounted
anomaly_codes.slfo_defs_not_exported: scene LFO (SLFO) defs counted at the engine constant, not exported
anomaly_codes.audio_input_dependency: preset depends on the external audio input path
anomaly_codes.class_state_unverified: FX class state not yet pinned (no_long_buffer or unverified tier)
anomaly_codes.class_traffic_unverified: FX class transactions not yet pinned
anomaly_codes.asset_bytes_unresolved: wavetable asset with neither embedded size nor resolved file record; bytes NOT guessed

determinism: same graph + same parameters => byte-identical result when dumped with sort_keys=True; floats rounded to 6 decimals; no timestamps or machine paths
